title: Return a location
summary: Spring Boot: Return a location. Inspect the first reply without following redirects.
introduction: A 302 reply with Location asks a browser to make another request. GET /start ends at /hello.
learningObjectives: Return a location with Spring Boot
Inspect the first reply without following redirects

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Return a location

blocks.text: The first response has status 302 and a Location header. The browser follows it to the greeting.
Inspect the first reply without following redirects.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Redirects are client actions, not calls to another Java method.
